tests.name: group detail is mounted and refuses an unsigned caller (read-only)

tests.reason: sending a tagged group message is a write, so it is proven here: only members whose @name is in the text are stored (never the sender, bot, service or test accounts), a tagged member gets exactly one chat_mention push in their language deep-linking to the message, everyone else the unchanged new_chat_message, a failed account lookup fails closed, GET /:id marks unmentionable accounts; the new catalog key is translated in every shipped locale. The signed-in roster check (`mentionable` on GET /chat/groups/:id) runs in the community-app staging suite (exafyltd/vitana-v1 docs/validation/VTID-04926).
